description: Alignment training runs on the RTX 4090 and deterministic evaluation of align_v3 on 200 predetermined seeds.
hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, driver 595.91.07, CUDA 13.0, 32 CPU cores

align_v1.outcome: diverged: action-change penalty on unclipped samples; stopped at about 22M steps

align_v2.outcome: diverged: KL 0.16 -> ~300 between 12.7M and 15.9M steps at learning rate 0.015; stopped at about 21M steps

summary.evaluator: Puffer CPU PufferNet, deterministic mean action
Puffer CPU PufferNet, deterministic mean action

video_seed_selection.rule: first evaluation seeds covering four distinct targets, chosen from the scripted baseline record before any learned-policy evaluation
